findings.issue: Composite country and chronology statements include components whose sources differ from the single source attached to the claim or profile fact.
examples: Ualá operating origin comes from s12, while regional HQ comes from s13; the combined fact cites s12 only.
tapi founder roots come from s17, while the named Argentine operating entity comes from s27; combined fact cites s17.
Rebill YC location comes from s03, while independent Argentine-origin reporting comes from s21; combined fact cites s03.
belo Argentine wallet statement comes from s04, launch and initial market from s16, and Uruguayan developer from s30; combined fact cites s04.
belo launch-date fact references unresolved2020 founding from s23 but cites only the company launch story s16.
findings.recommended_change: Split these into atomic source-specific facts. Keep Argentina inclusion distinct from regional HQ, local legal entity domicile, developer incorporation and global parent geography. Alternatively narrow each claim to what its attached source supports; retain the other observation under its own source.

findings.issue: All seven country_basis claim values are strings, while country_basis in the packet is an object. Other332-minus7 claim paths resolve directly to equal values.
findings.recommended_change: Use country_basis.basis as the claim path, or explicitly document that path labels are conceptual and are not JSON paths. The former is a small consistent correction and allows mechanical claim/projection validation.
